# truenas_failover_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS Enterprise HA failover configuration and live status. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one failover configuration per TrueNAS system. Makes no changes — see the truenas_failover_config resource's schema description for the safety notes around the "disabled" and "master" fields. Reads cleanly even on a box that isn't licensed for Enterprise HA (probed live): "status" reads "SINGLE" and "node" reads "MANUAL" in that case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "truenas_failover_config" "config" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether HA failover is currently administratively disabled on this system.
- `disabled_reasons` (List of String) Reasons why failover is currently disabled/non-functional (failover.disabled.reasons). An empty list when failover is fully enabled and functional.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "failover_config".
- `master` (Boolean) Whether this node in the chassis is currently marked master (active); the standby node has the opposite value.
- `node` (String) Slot position of this controller in the chassis (failover.node): "A", "B", or "MANUAL" if the position could not be determined (e.g. a non-HA box).
- `status` (String) Current HA status of this node (failover.status): one of "MASTER", "BACKUP", "ELECTING", "IMPORTING", "ERROR", or "SINGLE" (a box that isn't licensed/configured for HA).
- `timeout` (Number) Time to wait, in seconds, before a failover occurs after a network event on an interface marked critical for failover.
